scope: Chest opening animation and a separate standalone commercial UI proposal

game.tradeoff: Separate instanced body and lid submissions replace one source; completed transforms are frozen and only active openings update each frame.

validation.visualReview: Nine offline Blender views of the actual runtime geometry and hinge matrices with the existing texture; not gameplay screenshots.
validation.limitations: Node DOM and Babylon NullEngine cover logic, lifetime and render submission contracts. They do not measure hardware GPU time or device FPS. Mobile gameplay is not visually certified.

uiProposal.limitations: Some historical scene compositions show earlier controls. Latest values are identified in the interactive proposal. Dedicated final toolbar art is still required.
